title: Perfluorobutanoic acid: A short-chain perfluoroalkyl substance exhibiting estrogenic effects through the estrogen-related receptor gamma pathways.
authors: Li, Fangfang; Chen, Lu; Shi, Sha; Hong, Wen-Jun; Li, Minjie; Guo, Liang-Hong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PFBA通过ERRgamma通路产生雌激素效应，属于环境毒理学与内分泌干扰机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Perfluorobutanoic acid (PFBA) is an emerging contaminant that was demonstrated to exhibit estrogen effects via action on classic estrogen receptors (ERs) in a low-activity manner. The purpose of the present study is to reveal the estrogen disruption effect and mechanism of PFBA via estrogen-related receptor gamma (ERRgamma) pathways. In vivo experiment indicated that PFBA accumulated in zebrafish ovary and caused ovarian injury, with disturbing sex hormone levels and interfering gene expression related to estrogen synthesis and follicle regulation. In vitro, with cell proliferation assay, PFBA could promote estrogen-sensitive endometrial cancer cell Ishikawa proliferation at lowest observed effective concentrations (LOEC) 10 nM, which was close to human exposure levels. And cell proliferation was inhibited by ERRgamma antagonist GSK5182. By fluorescence competitive binding assay, molecular docking and luciferase reporter gene assays, it demonstrated that PFBA could directly bind with ERRgamma and activate ERRgamma transcriptional activities with a LOEC of 10 nM. Furthermore, PFBA up-regulated the proliferation-related factors downstream of ERRgamma and inhibited by PI3K/Akt inhibitor LY294002, which also suppressed the cell proliferation induced by PFBA. Taken together, the results revealed that PFBA had estrogen effects at the human-related exposure concentration, and demonstrated a new estrogen effects mechanism of PFBA via ERRgamma pathway.
abstract_zh: 全氟丁酸（PFBA）是一种新兴污染物，已被证明通过作用于经典雌激素受体（ERs）以低活性方式表现出雌激素效应。本研究旨在揭示PFBA通过雌激素相关受体γ（ERRgamma）通路产生的雌激素干扰效应及其机制。体内实验表明，PFBA在斑马鱼卵巢中积累，导致卵巢损伤，扰乱性激素水平，并干扰与雌激素合成和卵泡调节相关的基因表达。在体外实验中，通过细胞增殖试验，PFBA在最低观察效应浓度（LOEC）10 nM下能促进雌激素敏感型子宫内膜癌细胞Ishikawa的增殖，该浓度接近人类暴露水平。且细胞增殖被ERRgamma拮抗剂GSK5182抑制。通过荧光竞争结合试验、分子对接和荧光素酶报告基因试验，证明PFBA能直接与ERRgamma结合，并以10 nM的LOEC激活ERRgamma转录活性。此外，PFBA上调了ERRgamma下游的增殖相关因子，而这些因子被PI3K/Akt抑制剂LY294002抑制，该抑制剂也抑制了PFBA诱导的细胞增殖。综合来看，结果表明PFBA在人类相关暴露浓度下具有雌激素效应，并揭示了PFBA通过ERRgamma通路产生雌激素效应的新机制。
